convert_detr_model_to_detectron2: run the converter script to convert a DETR model checkpoint to Detectron2 format
convert_model_from_url: run the converter to download and convert a DETR model from a URL to Detectron2 format
remap_coco_classes: run the converter to remap 92 DETR COCO classes to contiguous Detectron2 class indices
convert_backbone_weights: run the converter to remap DETR backbone layer names to Detectron2 ResNet naming conventions
save_converted_checkpoint: run the converter to save a converted DETR model checkpoint to a specified output path
